# Multi-Tenant Application Standards

This directory contains standards for designing and implementing multi-tenant applications.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/multi-tenant/README.md#std-app-mtn-001-multi-tenant-applications]

### STD-APP-MTN-001: Multi-Tenant Applications

Standards for implementing multi-tenant architectures including tenant isolation strategies, data segregation, configuration management, resource allocation, and tenant onboarding/offboarding.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/multi-tenant/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Secure tenant isolation and data segregation
- Scalable multi-tenant architecture patterns
- Consistent tenant management practices
- Performance isolation and resource fairness
- Compliance with data residency requirements
